verses.original: וּלְאַחְאָ֛ב שִׁבְעִ֥ים בָּנִ֖ים בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן יֵה֨וּא וַיִּכְתֹּב֩ סְפָרִ֜ים וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֶל־ שָׂרֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְאֶל־ הָאֹמְנִ֥ים אַחְאָ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’aḥ·’āḇ šiḇ·‘îm bā·nîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn yê·hū way·yiḵ·tōḇ sə·p̄ā·rîm way·yiš·laḥ šō·mə·rō·wn ’el- śā·rê yiz·rə·‘el haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·’el- hā·’ō·mə·nîm ’aḥ·’āḇ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel to the elders and to the guardians [of the sons] of Ahab saying

verses.original: הַזֶּה֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם הַסֵּ֤פֶר כְּבֹ֨א וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י וְאִתְּכֶ֖ם וְאִתְּכֶם֙ הָרֶ֣כֶב וְהַסּוּסִ֔ים מִבְצָ֖ר וְעִ֥יר וְהַנָּֽשֶׁק׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zeh ’ă·lê·ḵem has·sê·p̄er kə·ḇō wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem bə·nê wə·’it·tə·ḵem wə·’it·tə·ḵem hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·has·sū·sîm miḇ·ṣār wə·‘îr wə·han·nā·šeq
verses.literal: When this . . . letter arrives since your master’s sons are with you and you have chariots and horses a fortified city and weaponry

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶ֞ם הַטּ֤וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁר֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וְשַׂמְתֶּ֖ם עַל־ אָבִ֑יו כִּסֵּ֣א וְהִֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ אֲדֹנֵיכֶֽם׃ בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’î·ṯem haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·hay·yā·šār mib·bə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem wə·śam·tem ‘al- ’ā·ḇîw kis·sê wə·hil·lā·ḥă·mū ‘al- ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem bêṯ
verses.literal: select the best and most worthy son of your master set him on his father’s throne and fight for your master’s house

verses.original: וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֵּה֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִ֔ים לֹ֥א עָמְד֖וּ לְפָנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖יךְ נַעֲמֹ֥ד אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū mə·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mə·rū hin·nêh šə·nê ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lō ‘ā·mə·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·’êḵ na·‘ă·mōḏ ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: But they were terrified . . . . . . and reasoned If two kings could not stand against him how . . . can we

verses.original: הַבַּ֣יִת אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ וַאֲשֶׁ֪ר עַל־ הָעִ֟יר וְהַזְּקֵנִים֩ וְהָאֹמְנִ֨ים וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶל־ יֵה֤וּא׀ לֵאמֹר֙ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ לֹֽא־ אִ֔ישׁ נַמְלִ֣יךְ עֲשֵֽׂה׃ הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer- ‘al- wa·’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘îr wə·haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·hā·’ō·mə·nîm way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yê·hū lê·mōr ’ă·naḥ·nū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā na·‘ă·śeh wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tō·mar ’ê·lê·nū lō- ’îš nam·lîḵ ‘ă·śêh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: So the palace administrator . . . the overseer . . . of the city the elders and the guardians sent a message to Jehu We are your servants and we will do whatever - you say . . . We will not make anyone king Do [whatever is] good in your sight

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֲלֵיהֶם֩ שֵׁנִ֜ית סֵ֨פֶר׀ לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־ לִ֨י אַתֶּ֜ם וּלְקֹלִ֣י׀ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֗ים קְחוּ֙ רָאשֵׁי֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֹ֧אוּ אֵלַ֛י בְנֵֽי־ אֶת־ יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָה כָּעֵ֥ת מָחָ֖ר וּבְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־ מְגַדְּלִ֥ים אוֹתָֽם׃ גְּדֹלֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ ’ă·lê·hem šê·nîṯ sê·p̄er lê·mōr ’im- lî ’at·tem ū·lə·qō·lî ’at·tem šō·mə·‘îm qə·ḥū rā·šê ’an·šê ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem ū·ḇō·’ū ’ê·lay ḇə·nê- ’eṯ- yiz·rə·‘e·lāh kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ū·ḇə·nê ham·me·leḵ šiḇ·‘îm ’îš ’eṯ- mə·ḡad·də·lîm ’ō·w·ṯām gə·ḏō·lê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter and said If vvv you are on my side - and if you will obey me then bring the heads . . . of your master’s . . . . . . sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow Now the sons of the king seventy in all . . . were being brought up - by the leading men of the city

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הַסֵּ֙פֶר֙ כְּבֹ֤א אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ אֶת־ רָֽאשֵׁיהֶם֙ בַּדּוּדִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî has·sê·p̄er kə·ḇō ’ă·lê·hem way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·ḥă·ṭū šiḇ·‘îm ’îš way·yā·śî·mū ’eṯ- rā·šê·hem bad·dū·ḏîm way·yiš·lə·ḥū ’ê·lāw yiz·rə·‘e·lāh
verses.literal: And when the letter arrived . . . they took - the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them They put - their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel

verses.original: הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ וַיָּבֹ֤א וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֣וֹ הֵבִ֖יאוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֵאמֹ֔ר שִׂ֣ימוּ אֹתָ֞ם שְׁנֵ֧י צִבֻּרִ֛ים פֶּ֥תַח הַשַּׁ֖עַר עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mal·’āḵ way·yā·ḇō way·yag·geḏ- lōw hê·ḇî·’ū rā·šê ḇə·nê- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer lê·mōr śî·mū ’ō·ṯām šə·nê ṣib·bu·rîm pe·ṯaḥ haš·ša·‘ar ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer
verses.literal: When the messenger arrived he told [Jehu] They have brought the heads of the sons of the king . . . And [Jehu] ordered Pile them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until morning

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיֵּצֵ֣א וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַתֶּ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צַדִּקִ֖ים אֲנִ֜י קָשַׁ֤רְתִּי עַל־ אֲדֹנִי֙ וָאֶהְרְגֵ֔הוּ וּמִ֥י הִכָּ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer way·yê·ṣê way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yō·mer ’at·tem hin·nêh ṣad·di·qîm ’ă·nî qā·šar·tî ‘al- ’ă·ḏō·nî wā·’eh·rə·ḡê·hū ū·mî hik·kāh ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: - The next morning [Jehu] went out and stood before all the people and said You . . . are innocent It was I who conspired against my master and killed him But who killed - all these

verses.original: דְּע֣וּ אֵפ֗וֹא כִּי֩ לֹ֨א מִדְּבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב יִפֹּ֜ל אַ֔רְצָה וַיהוָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד עַבְדּ֥וֹ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: də·‘ū ’ê·p̄ō·w kî lō mid·də·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ‘al- bêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ yip·pōl ’ar·ṣāh Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh ’êṯ ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ ‘aḇ·dōw ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: Know then that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail . . . for the LORD has done - what He promised through His servant Elijah

verses.original: יֵה֗וּא אֵ֣ת וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־ בְּיִזְרְעֶ֔אל הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֤ים לְבֵית־ אַחְאָב֙ וְכָל־ גְּדֹלָ֖יו וּמְיֻדָּעָ֣יו וְכֹהֲנָ֑יו עַד־ הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū ’êṯ way·yaḵ kāl- bə·yiz·rə·‘el han·niš·’ā·rîm lə·ḇêṯ- ’aḥ·’āḇ wə·ḵāl gə·ḏō·lāw ū·mə·yud·dā·‘āw wə·ḵō·hă·nāw ‘aḏ- hiš·’îr- lōw bil·tî śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: So Jehu - killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab as well as all his great men and close friends and priests . . . leaving him without [a single] survivor

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיָּבֹ֔א וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן ה֛וּא בֵּֽית־ עֵ֥קֶד הָרֹעִ֖ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yā·ḇō way·yê·leḵ šō·mə·rō·wn hū bêṯ- ‘ê·qeḏ hā·rō·‘îm bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Then [Jehu] set out . . . . . . toward Samaria . . . vvv At Beth-eked of the Shepherds -

verses.original: וְיֵה֗וּא מָצָא֙ אֶת־ אֲחֵי֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִ֣י אַתֶּ֑ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֲחֵ֤י אֲחַזְיָ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ וַנֵּ֛רֶד לִשְׁל֥וֹם בְּנֵֽי־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וּבְנֵ֥י הַגְּבִירָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū mā·ṣā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer mî ’at·tem ’ă·naḥ·nū ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū way·yō·mə·rū wan·nê·reḏ liš·lō·wm bə·nê- ham·me·leḵ ū·ḇə·nê hag·gə·ḇî·rāh
verses.literal: Jehu met - some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked Who are you We are relatives of Ahaziah they answered and we have come down to greet the sons of the king [and] of the queen mother

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֔ים וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂ֖וּם חַיִּ֑ים וַֽיִּשְׁחָט֞וּם אֶל־ בּ֣וֹר בֵּֽית־ עֵ֗קֶד אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֙יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְלֹֽא־ הִשְׁאִ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ מֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer tip̄·śūm ḥay·yîm way·yiṯ·pə·śūm ḥay·yîm way·yiš·ḥā·ṭūm ’el- bō·wr bêṯ- ‘ê·qeḏ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·na·yim ’îš wə·lō- hiš·’îr ’îš mê·hem
verses.literal: Then Jehu ordered Take them alive So [his men] took them alive then slaughtered them at the well vvv of Beth-eked forty-two . . . men He spared none of them

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֡ם וַיִּמְצָ֣א אֶת־ יְהוֹנָדָב֩ בֶּן־ רֵכָ֨ב לִקְרָאת֜וֹ וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲיֵ֧שׁ אֶת־ לְבָבְךָ֣ יָשָׁ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לְבָבִי֙ עִם־ לְבָבֶ֔ךָ יֵ֛שׁ יְהוֹנָדָ֥ב וַיֹּ֨אמֶר וָיֵ֖שׁ תְּנָ֣ה אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יָד֔וֹ וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ אֵלָ֖יו הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה׃ אֶל־
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ liq·rā·ṯōw way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hă·yêš ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā yā·šār ka·’ă·šer lə·ḇā·ḇî ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā yêš yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ way·yō·mer wā·yêš tə·nāh ’eṯ- yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yit·tên yā·ḏōw way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ’ê·lāw ham·mer·kā·ḇāh ’el-
verses.literal: When he left there he found - Jehonadab son of Rechab who was coming to meet him [Jehu] greeted him and asked Is . . . your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours It is Jehonadab replied “If it is,” said Jehu give me your hand So he gave him his hand and Jehu helped him into his chariot . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְכָ֣ה אִתִּ֔י וּרְאֵ֖ה בְּקִנְאָתִ֣י לַיהוָ֑ה וַיַּרְכִּ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּרִכְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ḵāh ’it·tî ū·rə·’êh bə·qin·’ā·ṯî Yah·weh way·yar·ki·ḇū ’ō·ṯōw bə·riḵ·bōw
verses.literal: saying Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD So he had him ride - in his chariot

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַ֠יַּךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ לְאַחְאָ֛ב הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֧ים בְּשֹׁמְר֖וֹן עַד־ הִשְׁמִיד֑וֹ כִּדְבַ֣ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל־ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·wn way·yaḵ ’eṯ- kāl- lə·’aḥ·’āḇ han·niš·’ā·rîm bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘aḏ- hiš·mî·ḏōw kiḏ·ḇar ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: When Jehu came to Samaria he struck down - everyone belonging to Ahab who remained [there] until he had destroyed them according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah

verses.original: יֵהוּא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַחְאָ֕ב עָבַ֥ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֖עַל מְעָ֑ט יֵה֖וּא יַעַבְדֶ֥נּוּ הַרְבֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yiq·bōṣ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’aḥ·’āḇ ‘ā·ḇaḏ ’eṯ- hab·ba·‘al mə·‘āṭ yê·hū ya·‘aḇ·ḏen·nū har·bêh
verses.literal: Then Jehu - brought all the people together and said - Ahab served - Baal a little but Jehu will serve him a lot

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה קִרְא֨וּ אֵלַ֜י כָל־ נְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֡עַל כָּל־ עֹבְדָ֣יו וְכָל־ כֹּהֲנָיו֩ אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יִפָּקֵ֗ד כִּי֩ לִי֙ גָּד֥וֹל זֶ֨בַח לַבַּ֔עַל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִפָּקֵ֖ד לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֑ה וְיֵהוּא֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בְעָקְבָּ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן הַאֲבִ֖יד אֶת־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qir·’ū ’ê·lay ḵāl nə·ḇî·’ê hab·ba·‘al kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏāw wə·ḵāl kō·hă·nāw ’îš ’al- yip·pā·qêḏ kî lî gā·ḏō·wl ze·ḇaḥ lab·ba·‘al kōl ’ă·šer- yip·pā·qêḏ lō yiḥ·yeh wə·yê·hū ‘ā·śāh ḇə·‘ā·qə·bāh lə·ma·‘an ha·’ă·ḇîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: Now, therefore summon to me all the prophets of Baal all his servants and all his priests See that no one . . . is missing for I have a great sacrifice for Baal Whoever - is missing will not live But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy - the servants of Baal

verses.original: יֵה֗וּא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר קַדְּשׁ֧וּ עֲצָרָ֛ה לַבַּ֖עַל וַיִּקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū way·yō·mer qad·də·šū ‘ă·ṣā·rāh lab·ba·‘al way·yiq·rā·’ū
verses.literal: And Jehu commanded Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal So they announced it

verses.original: יֵהוּא֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּל־ עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־ אִ֖ישׁ נִשְׁאַ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ בָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל בֵית־ הַבַּ֖עַל וַיִּמָּלֵ֥א פֶּ֥ה לָפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū way·yiš·laḥ bə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al way·yā·ḇō·’ū wə·lō- ’îš niš·’ar ’ă·šer lō- ḇā way·yā·ḇō·’ū bêṯ hab·ba·‘al ḇêṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yim·mā·lê peh lā·p̄eh
verses.literal: Then Jehu sent word throughout Israel and all the servants of Baal came there was not a man - who failed to show They entered the temple of Baal and it . . . was filled from end to end

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ הַמֶּלְתָּחָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֣א לְב֔וּשׁ לְכֹ֖ל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּצֵ֥א הַמַּלְבּֽוּשׁ׃ לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer la·’ă·šer ‘al- ham·mel·tā·ḥāh hō·w·ṣê lə·ḇūš lə·ḵōl ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·bā·‘al way·yō·ṣê ham·mal·būš lā·hem
verses.literal: And [Jehu] said to the keeper . . . of the wardrobe Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal So he brought out garments for them

verses.original: יֵה֛וּא וִיהוֹנָדָ֥ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֖ב וַיָּבֹ֥א בֵּ֣ית הַבָּ֑עַל וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְעֹבְדֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל חַפְּשׂ֤וּ וּרְאוּ֙ יֶשׁ־ פֶּן־ מֵעַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֹּ֤ה עִמָּכֶם֙ כִּ֛י אִם־ עֹבְדֵ֥י הַבַּ֖עַל לְבַדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū wî·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ way·yā·ḇō bêṯ hab·bā·‘al way·yō·mer lə·‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al ḥap·pə·śū ū·rə·’ū yeš- pen- mê·‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh pōh ‘im·mā·ḵem kî ’im- ‘ō·ḇə·ḏê hab·ba·‘al lə·ḇad·dām
verses.literal: Next, Jehu and Jehonadab son of Rechab entered the temple of Baal and Jehu said to the servants of Baal Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you only . . . servants of Baal . . .

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת זְבָחִ֣ים וְעֹל֑וֹת וְיֵה֞וּא שָׂם־ ל֤וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ בַחוּץ֙ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא עַל־ יְדֵיכֶ֔ם יִמָּלֵט֙ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ zə·ḇā·ḥîm wə·‘ō·lō·wṯ wə·yê·hū śām- lōw šə·mō·nîm ’îš ḇa·ḥūṣ way·yō·mer hā·’îš ’ă·šer- min- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mê·ḇî ‘al- yə·ḏê·ḵem yim·mā·lêṭ nap̄·šōw ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: And they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings Now Jehu had stationed eighty men outside and warned them If anyone - allows one of the men - I am delivering into your hands to escape he will forfeit his life for theirs

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כְּכַלֹּת֣וֹ׀ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הָעֹלָ֗ה יֵ֠הוּא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָרָצִ֨ים וְלַשָּׁלִשִׁ֜ים בֹּ֤אוּ הַכּוּם֙ אַל־ אִ֣ישׁ יֵצֵ֔א הָֽרָצִים֙ וְהַשָּׁ֣לִשִׁ֔ים וַיַּכּ֖וּם לְפִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיַּשְׁלִ֗כוּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ עַד־ עִ֥יר בֵּית־ הַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lāh yê·hū way·yō·mer lā·rā·ṣîm wə·laš·šā·li·šîm bō·’ū hak·kūm ’al- ’îš yê·ṣê hā·rā·ṣîm wə·haš·šā·li·šîm way·yak·kūm lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ way·yaš·li·ḵū way·yê·lə·ḵū ‘aḏ- ‘îr bêṯ- hab·bā·‘al
verses.literal: - When he had finished making the burnt offering Jehu said to the guards and officers Go in and kill them Do not let anyone out So the guards and officers put them vvv to the sword threw [the bodies] out and went into the inner room of the temple of Baal

verses.original: וַיֹּצִ֛אוּ אֶת־ מַצְּב֥וֹת בֵּית־ הַבַּ֖עַל וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣi·’ū ’eṯ- maṣ·ṣə·ḇō·wṯ bêṯ- hab·ba·‘al way·yiś·rə·p̄ū·hā
verses.literal: They brought out - the [sacred] pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבָּ֑עַל וַֽיִּתְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַבַּ֔עַל וַיְשִׂמֻ֥הוּ לְמַחֲרָאוֹת עַד־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·ṣū ’êṯ maṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ hab·bā·‘al way·yit·tə·ṣū ’eṯ- bêṯ hab·ba·‘al way·śi·mu·hū lə·ma·ḥă·rå̄·ʾōṯ ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: They also demolished - the [sacred] pillar of Baal Then they tore down - the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine which it is to this day

verses.original: יֵה֛וּא אֶת־ וַיַּשְׁמֵ֥ד הַבַּ֖עַל מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū ’eṯ- way·yaš·mêḏ hab·ba·‘al mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Thus Jehu - eradicated Baal from Israel

verses.original: רַ֠ק יֵה֖וּא לֹֽא־ סָ֥ר מֵאַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם חֲטָאֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית־ עֶגְלֵי֙ אֵ֖ל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּדָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: raq yê·hū lō- sār mê·’a·ḥă·rê·hem ḥă·ṭā·’ê yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer bêṯ- ‘eḡ·lê ’êl wa·’ă·šer bə·ḏān
verses.literal: but [he] did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat - had caused Israel to commit - the worship of the golden - calves at Bethel - and Dan

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ יֵה֗וּא יַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר־ הֱטִיבֹ֙תָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת הַיָּשָׁר֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְבֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּלְבָבִ֔י רְבִעִ֔ים בְּנֵ֣י יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְךָ֖ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- yê·hū ya·‘an ’ă·šer- hĕ·ṭî·ḇō·ṯā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nay ‘ā·śî·ṯā lə·ḇêṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer bil·ḇā·ḇî rə·ḇi·‘îm bə·nê yê·šə·ḇū lə·ḵā ‘al- kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Nevertheless, the LORD said to Jehu Because - you have done well in carrying out what is right in My sight and have done to the house of Ahab all that was in My heart four generations of your sons will sit on the throne of Israel

verses.original: וְיֵה֗וּא לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ר לָלֶ֛כֶת בְּתֽוֹרַת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ לְבָב֑וֹ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵעַל֙ חַטֹּ֣אות אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·hū lō šā·mar lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ṯō·w·raṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇōw lō sār mê·‘al ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ă·šer yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Yet Jehu was not careful to follow the instruction of the LORD the God of Israel with all his heart He did not turn away from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit -

verses.original: הָהֵ֔ם בַּיָּמִ֣ים יְהוָ֔ה הֵחֵ֣ל לְקַצּ֖וֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזָאֵ֖ל וַיַּכֵּ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ בְּכָל־ גְּב֥וּל
verses.transliteration: hā·hêm bay·yā·mîm Yah·weh hê·ḥêl lə·qaṣ·ṣō·wṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·zā·’êl way·yak·kêm yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl gə·ḇūl
verses.literal: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel Hazael defeated the Israelites throughout their territory

verses.original: מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הַגָּדִ֥י וְהָרֻאובֵנִ֖י וְהַֽמְנַשִּׁ֑י מֵעֲרֹעֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ אַרְנֹ֔ן נַ֣חַל וְהַגִּלְעָ֖ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: min- hay·yar·dên miz·raḥ haš·še·meš ’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ hag·gā·ḏî wə·hā·ru·w·ḇê·nî wə·ham·naš·šî mê·‘ă·rō·‘êr ’ă·šer ‘al- ’ar·nōn na·ḥal wə·hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·hab·bā·šān
verses.literal: from the Jordan eastward . . . - through all the land of Gilead the region of Gad Reuben and Manasseh and from Aroer - by the Arnon Valley through Gilead to Bashan

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֵה֛וּא וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְכָל־ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yê·hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehu along with all his accomplishments . . . and all his might . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel

verses.original: יֵהוּא֙ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּנ֖וֹ יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yê·hū way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bə·šō·mə·rō·wn bə·nōw yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried - in Samaria and his son Jehoahaz reigned in his place

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵהוּא֙ מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶֽה־ שָׁנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer yê·hū mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·neh- šā·nāh
verses.literal: So the duration - of Jehu’s reign over Israel in Samaria [was] twenty-eight . . . years
